records.generation_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production game material swatch atlas, 1536x1024, EXACT 3 columns by 2 rows, each swatch fills its complete 512x512 cell, NO gutters, NO text, NO borders. Six separate flat material textures, NOT isometric cubes, NOT scenes. All texture colors harmonize as one charming coastal fantasy world. Row1 left: top-down green meadow ground, broad mint/jade and yellow-green moss clusters, little tiny clover-shaped leaves only in some patches, 70% calm low-detail ground and 30% grouped organic detail, NO flowers or rocks or props. Row1 middle: top-down warm pale peach and golden cream sand, subtle curved wind ripples and a few small warm pebbles, mostly calm. Row1 right: top-down transparent turquoise lagoon water, broad jade blue areas with loose elegant pale aqua caustic curves, a few short creamy glints, NO shore, NO objects. These three top textures must tile seamlessly in both axes, equal brightness at boundaries, no vignette. Row2 left: a FLAT front elevation cutaway earth wall, a narrow irregular fresh grass fringe across top 15%, warm ochre terracotta soil and large broken cool mauve slate stones embedded below, a few thin curving roots, irregular organic strata, NOT horizontal uniform stripes. Row2 middle: FLAT front elevation cutaway sandy limestone wall, cream sand at top 15%, softly angular golden ochre and pinkish sandstone plates below, 3 large irregular cracked forms, NOT stacked regular stripes. Row2 right: FLAT front elevation water depth, turquoise upper half drifting toward deep petrol blue bottom, a few wide refraction streaks, elegant clear pools of color. Bottom textures must repeat horizontally only, their grass/sand rims and waterline belong at y=0 within each cell. Soft warm light from upper left, cool violet shadows, all materials have equal detail scale. Art directed, calm readable masses, not noisy generic procedural textures. No objects, no vegetation taller than grass, no icons, no labels.
Style: masterful hand-painted gouache fantasy videogame texture work, charming illustrated storybook, deliberate broad visible pigment strokes and softly faceted shapes, matte finish, varied brush sizes, sophisticated warm/cool color harmony, fresh daylight. No black outlines, no photorealistic micrograin, no bevel filters, no pixelation, no plastic 3D. Hand-painted brushwork must remain visible even at small size.

records.generation_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create an ORIGINAL production sprite atlas for a charming coastal fantasy map game. Genuine transparent RGBA background. Landscape 1536x1024 divided into exactly THREE columns and TWO rows, each cell512x512. One small isolated object in each cell. CRITICAL GUTTERS: all opaque content of each object must fit x=96..416 and y=96..432 within its cell; all bottoms align y=432. Lots of empty transparent space. No object crosses cell borders. No labels, no grid, no background, no platform or tile pedestal. 2:1 isometric view from above, all grounded at bottom center, soft warm upper-left sunlight, cool teal and lavender shaded planes. One unified palette of jade green, dusty turquoise, warm cream, soft ochre and coral red. Row1 left: an inviting small windswept oak, gracefully curved trunk and FOUR or FIVE broad rounded foliage masses, grouped leaves expressed in large shapes, not individual needles. Row1 middle: three softly angular blue-grey ancient stones with a few mint moss patches and ONE tiny gold spiral engraving in the main stone. Row1 right: a small wooden explorer's supply chest, weathered muted teal painted lid, honey oak sides, two simple brass bands, readable chunky proportions. Row2 left: a charming cluster of three coral-pink mushrooms, creamy stems, a few big ivory cap spots and two tiny mint leaves at their base. Row2 middle: a young bent coconut palm with just seven broad sweeping jade fronds, readable negative space between leaves, ochre trunk, two coconuts, a few small pale pink seashells at its base. Row2 right: a short storybook lighthouse, gently tapered ivory plaster tower with one wide coral stripe, tiny teal conical roof, warm amber lantern room, low blue-grey stone base with two green plants. Emphasize silhouettes and BIG SIMPLE SHAPES, broad material planes, controlled sparse detail. Not realistic, not finely engraved, not mobile-game glossy, not noisy illustration. Tiny contact shadows only.
Art style: lush hand-painted GOUACHE storybook game illustration, matte pigments, loose expressive brush edges within clean silhouettes, chunky simplified forms, harmonious softly muted colors with warm highlights. Visible strokes and painted edge variation; absolutely no black contour outlines, no photorealistic bark, no tiny busy foliage, no gradient airbrush look, no pseudo-pixel art. Charming miniature environment props, worldbuilding through shape and palette.

Whole tree canopy must fit within firstcell x0..512, whole palm and lighthouse must fit within their bottomrowcell. Nothing may cross x512,x1024,y512. Keep generous empty space around small objects. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no background colors, no checkerboard, no shadows outside props. No other changes.
